compute_nansum: compute the sum of array elements along an axis while ignoring NaN values
compute_nanmean: compute the mean of array elements along an axis while ignoring NaN values
compute_nanvar: compute the variance of array elements along an axis while ignoring NaN values
compute_nancorr: compute the correlation between two arrays while ignoring NaN values using pearson, spearman, or kendall method
compute_nanstd: compute the standard deviation of array elements along an axis while ignoring NaN values
